inputs: Activity tick, away mode and away-message parameters.
defaults: AWAY_OFF and GET_TICK() initialize manager state. updateActivity defaults its time to GET_TICK().
effects: updateActivity ignores timestamps older than lastActivity; otherwise stores it and clears non-manual away. Second timer enters AWAY_IDLE only when AWAY_IDLE_TIME>0, current mode is OFF, and timeout has elapsed. setAway no-ops unchanged mode and refuses idle when timeout is disabled; manual transitions persist AWAY, non-OFF resets activity tick, then ClientManager myInfoUpdated and AwayModeChanged fire. getAwayMessage writes idleTI into caller params as formatted elapsed seconds before formatting the message.
events: Settings LoadCompleted applies AWAY=true as AWAY_MANUAL; Timer Second evaluates idle timeout; AwayModeChanged carries new mode.
behavior.completion: Synchronous state update and parameter formatting; timer/settings transitions execute from their callbacks.
behavior.cancellation: No cancellation API; destructor unregisters timer and settings listeners.
persistence: AWAY is written only for manual-away entry or manual->off transitions; idle state is not saved.

records.proposed_bridge_requirement: Expose configured away mode and derived away state separately.

acceptance_scenarios.then: lastActivity changes but away remains manual; a stale timestamp changes nothing.
the request is ignored and no AwayModeChanged event fires.
